'''Delia''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], who was a sister of a criminal named [[Vasco Nailhead]]. When the two were living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] as children, Vasco often sang to Delia a song called "''[[Sweet Fronda Fane]]''". When her brother was incarcerated in the prison facility [[Cog Hive Seven]], Delia regularly sent him letters, remembering their good times together on Tepasi.
